# ConcernsOnRails

> Plug-and-play ActiveSupport concerns for Rails models and controllers — one `include`, one declarative macro. 43 concerns covering slugs, soft delete, publishing, encryption, auditing, pagination, rate limiting, webhooks, params contracts, and more.

ConcernsOnRails is a Ruby gem (`gem "concerns_on_rails"`; Ruby >= 3.2, Rails 5.0–8.x). Current version: 1.25.0. Every link below is a standalone plain-Markdown document — fetch it directly, no JavaScript or HTML parsing required.

## Model concerns

- [Sluggable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/sluggable.md): URL-friendly slugs
- [Sortable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/sortable.md): List ordering via acts_as_list
- [Publishable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/publishable.md): published_at timestamp publishing
- [SoftDeletable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/soft-deletable.md): Soft delete with scopes & hooks
- [Hashable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/hashable.md): Auto-generate tokens / UUIDs / codes
- [Schedulable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/schedulable.md): starts_at / ends_at time windows
- [Expirable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/expirable.md): Single-timestamp expiry
- [Normalizable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/normalizable.md): Attribute normalization (:email, :phone…)
- [Searchable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/searchable.md): LIKE/ILIKE search across columns
- [Activatable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/activatable.md): Boolean active/inactive toggle
- [Tokenizable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/tokenizable.md): Security tokens, timing-safe lookup
- [Sequenceable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/sequenceable.md): Human-friendly reference numbers
- [Stateable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/stateable.md): String-backed state machine
- [Addressable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/addressable.md): Postal address normalization + validation
- [Taggable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/taggable.md): Lightweight tagging over one column
- [Sanitizable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/sanitizable.md): Opt-in HTML sanitization (XSS defense)
- [Maskable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/maskable.md): Non-destructive display masking
- [Monetizable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/monetizable.md): Integer-cents money columns (BigDecimal)
- [Auditable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/auditable.md): Single-column change history (paper_trail-lite)
- [Lockable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/lockable.md): Failed-attempt tracking + account lockout
- [Aliasable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/aliasable.md): Full read/write/query aliases for associations
- [Storable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/storable.md): Typed accessors over one JSON settings column
- [CounterCacheable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/counter-cacheable.md): Conditional denormalized association counters
- [Encryptable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/encryptable.md): Transparent field-level encryption (AES-256-GCM)
- [Anonymizable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/anonymizable.md): GDPR right-to-erasure with per-field strategies
- [Duplicable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/duplicable.md): Concern-aware deep copy with association allow-list

## Controller concerns

- [Paginatable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/paginatable.md): Offset pagination with headers
- [CursorPaginatable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/cursor-paginatable.md): Cursor (keyset) pagination with headers
- [Filterable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/filterable.md): Declarative URL-param filters
- [Sortable (controller)](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/sortable-controller.md): URL-param ordering with allow-list
- [Respondable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/respondable.md): Standardized JSON envelopes
- [ErrorHandleable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/error-handleable.md): JSON rescue_from handlers
- [Includable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/includable.md): Association sideloading + sparse fieldsets
- [SecureHeadable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/secure-headable.md): Security headers + native CSP DSL
- [Localizable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/localizable.md): Per-request locale from params / header
- [Authorizable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/authorizable.md): Per-action 403 authorization gate
- [Throttleable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/throttleable.md): Rate limiting (429 + X-RateLimit-*)
- [Timezoneable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/timezoneable.md): Per-request Time.zone from params / header
- [Idempotentable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/idempotentable.md): Idempotency-Key replay for mutating endpoints
- [WebhookVerifiable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/webhook-verifiable.md): HMAC verification for inbound webhooks
- [Deprecatable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/deprecatable.md): RFC Deprecation/Sunset headers + 410 enforcement
- [Cacheable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/cacheable.md): HTTP conditional GET (ETag / 304) + Cache-Control
- [Permittable](https://vsn2015.github.io/concerns_on_rails/concerns/permittable.md): Typed, validated params contracts + schema-drift guard
